reviews.comment: Dr. Thomas is decent at lecturing. She cares a lot for the students and does a great job helping with code tracing, but she codes alongside students as the lectures which makes it harder for inexperienced coders.
She is literally the goat. She answers all questions, works out problems on the board, and codes alongside students. She makes sure you are prepared for exam frqs. Very cool prof

Dr. Thomas is great! Her lectures are really well structured (everything posted on canvas), and you do lots of practice problems in class. She's quite receptive to questions too. Daily participation is tracked via Gradescope activities, but going to class is def worth it anyway.
120 is a weed out class so a lot of things are just because of the class design. She definitely cares, speaks in at a good pace and definitely is deserving of her rating. Would recommend.

Thomas is an excellent choice for this class, she is caring and diligent about teaching. As long as you go to the lecture and actually attempt and complete the homework yourself you will be fine. And if you ever have questions just ask her. She is an encyclopedia of knowledge for coding an a great teacher.

Professor Thomas went through the course content in an understandable way and always gave examples and engagement activities to ensure students learned the material. For exams, make sure to use the cheat sheets well and really emphasize the practice exams and example problems, especially code tracing.

The class wasn't hard, but the projects were time consuming. There was an individual project (personal website) and two team projects (Java POS system and web POS system). There were also a lot of writing components. Some of her grading comments were inaccurate and therefore hurtful, which disappointed me because I really liked her for CSCE 120.
The professor excels in office hours. Sometimes she makes the class examples on the fly or delves into her family life.

Pretty good prof. Codes alongside students which is more helpful than showing the final version of a program. Attendance counts, and it is lecture-heavy. Pay attention in the lecture and ask questions to do good in the course. The course is standardized among all sections, so the same exams, hw, labs, etc. TAs are also helpful. Also no slides.
She's an awesome prof, the class itself is fairly hard though.

Probably the best professor in terms of explaining things so far. Really makes confusing concepts simple and easy to understand and makes class engaging .Class is standardized amongst all profs but if you can attend her lectures. Seriously. She is the goat and I am extremely grateful I could take her class.

Dr. Thomas is an incredible professor and a lovely person. She explains otherwise challenging concepts very well and made dynamic memory make sense to me for the first time. She uses hand-drawn diagrams which are very useful to visualize concepts, though she doesn't have slides and I've heard that can be difficult for some. Overall, wonderful.
(This is for CSCE 482) LOVE Professor Thomas. She is a gem of a professor. Actually cares about your project and wants to see you succeed. Has a great attitude and is an overall wonderful person.

She is very nice but the class is so much work. You are constantly working on your projects and in the first 2/3rds of the semester, there are sooo many documents and papers you fill out with useless long readings. Try to learn useful tech stuff early because the readings you get are pointless. Be ready to work a lot in this class

Dr. Thomas is a wonderful and well-respected professor. The course and the way she teaches it are annoying. So much time was spent doing high school style busy-work that proved to be almost completely meaningless. So much time could have been used to teach useful technologies like React, Javascript, Git, etc. But these you had to learn on your own.

No exams; writing intensive; a lot of busywork. If you take this, please ensure that your other classes are on the easier side. You WILL spend 90% of your time on this class. Your "breaks" are just going to be time spent on projects. Class will teach you industry techniques, not coding, so prepare to self-learn Java and the tools your group chose.

Dr. Thomas herself is great and cares for her students. Her class however, was not. The main issue was that this class has way too much meaningless busywork. None of it's hard, it just takes forever to get through. The good parts were informative though and taught me a lot about software development.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Thomas is one of my favorite professors I have had in the comp sci department. Her lectures are actually helpful in advancing learning through the exercises you do and discussion. You can tell she actually cares if you learn. Being proactive with your group project will pay off dividends. Lots of work but doable completely to do well

Dr. Thomas is one of the best professors I've ever had. 315 is a very difficult class, but she's so kind and well-organized that nothing felt unreasonable or unfair. Truly the queen of TAMU's CompSci department.
Don't take the 8Am if you like yourself. She's basically the helpful person alive. Also, you can basically choose your teammates for the last project.

CSCE315 is TOUGH. There is a lot of work for this class, especially once group projects start. Dr. Thomas is great though. She is very enthusiastic which helps keep a good mental state throughout the semester. She is always accessible outside of class and does her best to help when asked. Ask questions and manage your time well, and you'll get an A
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Gonna be honest, I forgot to review this class because this was probably the most organized and fairest class I took this semester. Professor was awesome. Just recommend opening up LiveMache early because the servers can barely handle it.

Dr. Thomas is very enthusiastic during lectures. You can tell she really cares about her students. For the most part, your experience in this class will depend on the two groups you have for each of two projects. If your group works diligently you should have no problems meeting the deadlines and getting a good grade.
She was a great teacher. 315 is a lot of work but not to hard to get a good grade. Was really well organized and handled the shift to online better than any of my teachers

Dr. Thomas really cares for her students! A lot of the lecture portions are discussions over concepts that come up often in industry and the group projects give you a chance to work with those concepts. The TAs would sometimes be a bit late on answering project questions, but everything was kinda messy this semester anyway. Good class.

CSCE315 is a lot of work regardless of the professor (universal curriculum), and grading is largely done by TA's. However Professor Shawna is passionate and professional in her lectures. She goes out of her way to foster a great learning environment and truly cares about the students. The projects will be very difficult if you get a bad group.

Dr Thomas is a very caring and kind woman who genuinely always seems like she wants us to learn and grow. She is fairly flexible and will work with you if something comes up. The class is mostly group projects, and she sometimes gave us options to pref who was in our group. Instructions could be vague but I think she just wanted us to be creative.

One of the fairest graders I've had in the department! Gives ample partial credit anytime it's applicable on HWs, quizzes, and exams. Lectures and in-class examples (+ cheatsheet) prepare you well for the tests. Was worried about this class (had negative experience in 222), but Dr. Thomas made it a pleasure. Would highly recommend for 411!!
